source_contract.scope: Provider launch, scheduler safe boundaries, frozen-taskpack snapshot-root override, projection, release binding, post-backlog gates, and P0 readiness validation.
exclusions: This handoff is implementation guidance, not benchmark evidence.
It must not be supplied to single_codex mode.
It does not replace immutable protocol, run-manifest, release, sandbox, invocation-set, result-bundle, or gate-epoch authority.

repo_map_handoff.implementation_state: The mapped Phase 2 seams are present at the bound repository commit; consumers should extend or repair these common seams instead of adding parallel launch, scheduling, projection, or gate paths.

sequence: experiment_modes._register_provider_launch or TwoPhaseFileScheduler._register_experiment_attempt_launch publishes controller-owned lifecycle and sandbox registration
ModelInvocationCall.__init__ reloads the immutable registration with _bind_registered_experiment_launch
ModelInvocationCall.execute validates the registered Codex command, reloads the sandbox reference, builds bwrap launch policy, and acquires protocol-global admission before process preparation
ModelInvocationCall.finalize publishes terminal usage and calls ExperimentController.post_terminal_accounting
TwoPhaseFileScheduler.dispatch_ready checks pre_provider_launch and allocates a standalone experiment attempt repository
collect_ready_results imports or reconciles durable invocation lifecycles
_collect_result checks pre_integration before mutation and marks integration_active for the transaction
_integrate_accepted_result applies, verifies, commits, or rolls back without an intervening budget stop
_collect_result clears integration_active and observes post_integration before terminal scheduler state
ExperimentModeController executes exactly the declared adapter
single, direct, and full adapters register every model lifecycle through the common launch seam
ExperimentCommonFinalizer returns every mode to common evaluation, scan-scope publication, result sealing, and projection reconciliation
taskpack validation admits an empty backlog only for a candidate-release-bound controller_only taskpack with registered deterministic gates
agentteam._run_controller_only_taskpack seals or reloads the gate epoch
run_gate_controller recomputes the relation and pauses P2-09 until epoch-bound authorization exists
_evaluate_post_backlog_gates requires a current immutable controller result before milestone completion

bounded_gaps: The public experiment CLI exposes readiness, legacy validation/pilot guard, show, and compare; execution and resume currently enter through execute_bound_experiment_mode and controller APIs rather than experiment run/resume parser commands.
Legacy agentteam_experiment_manifest.v1 remains validation-only in experiment_readiness.py and must not be reused as Phase 2 execution authority.

ordering_contract: Supported-Codex classification occurs before ModelInvocationCall construction.
Immutable experiment launch registration is reloaded in ModelInvocationCall.__init__ and overrides only matching caller context.
Sandbox-reference validation and bwrap preparation occur in ModelInvocationCall.execute before provider admission and before runner preparation or Popen.
Protocol-global provider admission occurs before InvocationLifecycle.publish_start and process permit.
Post-terminal accounting consumes only InvocationLifecycle.finalize output and releases the provider lane after durable terminal authority exists.
common_launch_seam.future_extension_rule: Any new counted provider path must construct ModelInvocationCall and must not spawn Codex directly.

registration_and_sandbox_seams.purpose: Allocate per-lifecycle authority for single and author launches and build the immutable runtime context consumed by direct/full schedulers.
Allocate a workspace-specific sandbox reference and lifecycle registration before dispatching each worker attempt.
Own immutable sandbox, lifecycle registry, complete invocation-set sealing, trusted evaluator execution, and evaluation binding validation.

provider_call_sites.constraint: A diagnostic launched inside an experiment controller is budget-admitted; scored execution must deny it or give it a registered sandbox lifecycle.
Development smoke is a controller lifecycle, not a benchmark mode.
Phase 1 live acceptance remains separate from Phase 2 epoch-authorized live calibration.

context_projection_seams.invariant: experiment_run_id, mode, protocol/run-manifest digests, sandbox reference, controller reference, lifecycle authority, model, and reasoning profile must survive mailbox projection and start/terminal replay.

integration_risks: A direct Codex Popen or per-adapter wrapper bypasses sandbox, provider-lane, budget, and lifecycle authority.
Admission after runner preparation can create execution authority before the global budget decision.
Accounting before durable terminal publication can infer, lose, or double-count usage.
Accepting caller context that differs from immutable launch registration lets a provider substitute workspace, model, mode, or authority root.
Incomplete lifecycle registry sealing lets author, follow-up, or late provider starts escape evaluation coverage.

budget_safe_boundaries.invariant: Both the common invocation seam and scheduler dispatch fail closed; the common invocation seam is authoritative for every provider path.
Only authoritative terminal provider totals advance consumption; one already-admitted invocation may expose visible overshoot.
A denied integration preserves the accepted patch and does not mutate the baseline.
budget_stopped is reached only after the provider lane, scheduler inflight set, open invocation set, and integration transaction are all empty.

drain_resume_and_recovery.invariant: Resume reloads the original controller reference and frozen budget, reconciles open execution before dispatch, and never repeats a completed integration step.

post_backlog_gate_core.invariant: Only the closed P2-08/P2-09/P2-10 registry is executable; relation validation recomputes committed evidence, and P2-09 returns awaiting_operator_authorization with zero provider calls until current-epoch authorization passes.

integration_risks: A stop check inside the integration mutation sequence can leave apply, verification, commit, rollback, and scheduler state inconsistent.
Terminalizing budget_stopped while an invocation or provider lane remains open loses authoritative usage.
Trusting schema-valid gate claims without validate_gate_relation repeats the readiness gap.
Treating P2-09 authorization as post-run approval permits an unauthorized live provider call.
Executing a controller_only taskpack through the model-worker path can start providers despite an empty backlog.

primary_seam.behavior: After validating the frozen taskpack, _validated_trusted_project_root selects the controller-supplied standalone snapshot only for emitted --project-root; _rebase_taskpack_command rebases the trusted verification command without rewriting frozen taskpack bytes.

caller_seam.behavior: experiment_modes supplies trusted_project_root and an immutable experiment_runtime_context; _run_frozen_taskpack forces max_inflight=1 and passes the protocol model as trusted_model.

rules: Direct mode calls verify_frozen_taskpack_digest before applying the snapshot root.
Direct mode passes only the preregistered frozen taskpack and request.project_root.
Full mode authors in an independent standalone repository and rejects a digest equal to the preregistered direct taskpack.

controller_only_guard.invariant: Zero tasks and agents are valid only with execution_mode=controller_only, non-empty registered deterministic gates, blueprint_materialized provenance, candidate release binding, and no worker-pool launch.

integration_risks: Rewriting taskpack.yaml project_root invalidates the reviewed direct-taskpack digest.
Applying the root override before taskpack validation can conceal stale or malicious frozen authority.
Exposing trusted_project_root as a worker-controlled field can redirect execution outside the certified snapshot.
Reusing ordinary linked worktrees leaks object, ref, and prior-mode state.
Relaxing empty-backlog validation outside the controller_only predicate creates false completion.

projection.authority_model: Sealed result bundles and recovery snapshots remain authoritative files. SQLite is rebuilt from files, checked by counts and content digests, and readers fall back to files when stale or invalid.
projection.extension_rule: New experiment fields must be added to file scanning, table schema, row writing, projection counts, database counts, and digest reconciliation together.

result_publication.invariant: All terminal outcomes are create-if-absent sealed bundles; recovery snapshots are separate, and raw spools, Git objects, caches, DB files, and result staging are excluded from authoritative artifact bytes.

release.boundary: The implementation taskpack remains bound to its preflight release. After operator review, the integration commit is installed as an immutable candidate release; only a separately frozen, candidate-bound controller_only taskpack may execute P2-08 through P2-10.

readiness.invariant: P2-08 recomputes seven capability bindings and a zero-call pilot guard, P2-09 validates current-epoch authorization and sealed three-mode results, and P2-10 validates the exact single-parent report/roadmap child relation.

integration_risks: Making agentteam.db authoritative lets staleness or deletion change experiment truth.
Dropping failed, infrastructure_failed, interrupted, or budget_stopped bundles biases comparison.
Consulting the mutable active-release pointer after run binding permits runtime drift.
Hot-loading P2-07B from its own implementation run violates the two-taskpack release boundary.
Schema validation alone does not prove Git ancestry, exact changed paths, evidence digests, or zero-call guards.
